FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing. This kingdom's aesthetic is so...last season.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER JACK, approaches the king.

JESTER JACK
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm telling you, Jack, this kingdom's style is so...quaint. We need something new. Something...vaporwave.

JESTER JACK
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? I'm not sure I understand.

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
It's a style, Jack! A fusion of 80s nostalgia and futuristic weirdness. Think neon lights, distorted synths, and a dash of mysticism.

JESTER JACK
(skeptical)
I see. And how do you propose we achieve this...vaporwave aesthetic?

KING REGINALD
(determined)
We'll start by replacing the traditional suits of armor with...with... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...with these fabulous, iridescent jumpsuits!

The servant, SERVANT SALLY, looks on in confusion as the king gestures to a rack of shimmering, rainbow-colored jumpsuits.

SERVANT SALLY
(nervously)
Uh, Your Majesty? I think those might be a bit...unconventional.

KING REGINALD
(firmly)
Nonsense, Sally! These jumpsuits are the future! And we'll pair them with...with... (he consults a nearby scroll)...with these fabulous, glow-in-the-dark tapestries!

The tapestries, which depict fantastical creatures and mystical landscapes, are indeed glowing with an otherworldly light.

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
And we'll top it all off with...with... (he looks around)...with these fabulous, oversized, mirrored helmets!

The knights, who have been watching the exchange, look on in confusion as the king gestures to a rack of oversized, mirrored helmets.

KNEIGHT 1
(skeptically)
Uh, Your Majesty? I'm not sure those helmets are...practical.

KING REGINALD
(firmly)
Practical? Ha! We're not just a kingdom, we're a...a... (he searches for the right word)...a vaporwave kingdom!

As the king's vision takes shape, the kingdom begins to transform. The streets are filled with the sound of distorted synths and the sight of neon lights. The peasants, who had been going about their daily business, now look on in wonder as the kingdom's aesthetic is transformed.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors. The room is filled with the sound of distorted synths and the sight of glowing, neon lights.

KING REGINALD
(to his courtiers)
We must make this kingdom a beacon of...of... (he searches for the right word)...of vaporwave excellence!

COURTIER 1
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. We'll make sure to...to... (he consults a nearby scroll)...to incorporate more...more... (he searches for the right word)...more mysticism into our designs.

KING REGINALD
(firmly)
Mysticism? Ha! We're not just a kingdom, we're a...a... (he searches for the right word)...a vaporwave kingdom of the future!

As the king's vision takes shape, the courtiers and advisors look on in wonder, unsure of what to make of the king's new aesthetic.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a fully-fledged vaporwave kingdom. The streets are filled with the sound of distorted synths and the sight of neon lights. The peasants, who had been going about their daily business, now look on in wonder as the kingdom's aesthetic is transformed.

KING REGINALD
(to the peasants)
Welcome, my subjects, to our new...our new... (he searches for the right word)...our new vaporwave kingdom!

The peasants, who had been watching the exchange, look on in confusion, unsure of what to make of the king's new aesthetic.

FADE TO BLACK.
